The ForgeRock IDM Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and governing enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using the ForgeRock Identity Platform (On-Premise), with a primary focus on ForgeRock Identity Management (IDM).
q: 3+ years of hands-on ForgeRock IDM implementation and deployment experience.
Experience leading large-scale IAM transformation programs.
Experience implementing enterprise identity governance and lifecycle management solutions.
r: Configure automated provisioning and de-provisioning workflows.
Implement role-based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC).
Design identity reconciliation, attestation, and certification processes.
Enable self-service identity management and delegated administration capabilities.
Configure connectors, synchronization policies, mappings, workflows, and managed objects.
Develop custom integrations using REST APIs, Java, Groovy, JavaScript, and SCIM.
Support production deployments and platform upgrades.
Perform performance tuning and system optimization.
Investigate and resolve complex IAM-related issues.
Develop monitoring, logging, backup, and disaster recovery strategies.
Ensure high availability and scalability of the ForgeRock environment.
